purpose: Review risk-ranked proposals and collect human approval records without executing domain actions.
guardrails: HIGH and CRITICAL require two distinct HUMAN approvers
HIGH and CRITICAL require deterministic precheck PASS
HIGH and CRITICAL require FRESH evidence accepted for review
HIGH and CRITICAL human requesters cannot self-approve
approval records form a SHA-256 predecessor chain
APPROVED_FOR_SUBMISSION never changes executionState from NOT_EXECUTED
